''' Evgenii Georgievich Dyakonov''' ({{langx|ru|Евгений Георгиевич Дьяконов}}) (July 2, 1935 &ndash; August 11, 2006) was a Russian [[mathematician]].

Dyakonov was a Ph.D. student of [[Sergei Sobolev]]. He worked at the [[Moscow State University]]. He authored over hundred papers and several books. Dyakonov was recognized for his pioneering work in the 60s&ndash;80s on efficient [[Preconditioner|spectrally equivalent preconditioning]] for [[linear systems]] and [[eigenvalue]] problems. In the last decade, strengthened [[Sobolev space]]s became Dyakonov's main topic of research, e.g., (Dyakonov, 2004).
